name: AI Search - Semantic Chunking
description: Adds a semantic (embedding-similarity) chunking strategy to AI Search as a drop-in alternative to token-based chunking.
project_description:
AI Search - Semantic Chunking adds one Search API EmbeddingStrategy plugin (id semantic_chunks, label "Semantic Embedding Strategy") to the AI Search module. It behaves like AI Search's built-in Enriched (contextual_chunks) strategy — one embedding per chunk, with title and contextual content prepended — but replaces the fixed token-window chunker with a cosine-distance breakpoint chunker so chunk boundaries fall where the topic actually shifts.

Per document the plugin: cleans Markdown noise (MarkdownAwareSentenceSplitter decorator), splits main content into sentences (SentenceSplitter, abbreviation-aware, paragraph breaks are hard boundaries), embeds each distinct sentence once through the provider AI Search is wired to (via the drupal/ai provider abstraction, deduping identical sentences), computes cosine distance between consecutive sentences, uses the configured percentile of those distances as the split threshold, then walks the sentences starting a new chunk when a boundary distance exceeds the threshold and the current chunk has at least min_sentences_per_chunk sentences, or when appending the next sentence would exceed max_chunk_chars. Each assembled chunk is re-embedded with the title and contextual content prepended.

If the embedder throws, returns an unusable vector shape, or the document exceeds max_sentences_for_semantic sentences, the chunker falls back to plain character-based size chunking; if main content is empty or the semantic chunker returns nothing usable, the plugin defers to the parent token-based getChunks(). Cost model: roughly N + M embedding calls per document (N distinct sentences, M chunks); max_sentences_for_semantic is the main cost-containment knob. The strategy is selected per Search API index at /admin/config/search/search-api and requires an AI embedding provider already configured for AI Search.
